name: @compass/devenv-cli
description: Resolves the devenv CLI source from a named devenv.lock (parses .nodes.devenv.locked into a github:<owner>/<repo>/<rev>#devenv flakeref, and optionally realizes it into a single-binary shim dir). Shared by renovate.yml and ci.yml so neither hand-pins a devenv rev. Dependency-free by design — it runs in renovate.yml before `bun install` has, so it may import only bun/node builtins.
